ar.register: Modern Standard Arabic; direct imperatives are singular masculine/neutral in form.

de.register: Formal Sie in permission-error guidance; informal du may be used in playful loading copy.

es.decision: Recommend Asegúrese at W1039/W1040 to align the corresponding unsuffixed messages; keep informal tú in conversational loading copy.
es.register: Catalog is mixed: tú occurs in general copy and playful loading messages; usted occurs in some server validations. Exact paired folder-permission messages use Asegúrese.

fr.register: Polite vous for server guidance and user-directed loading prompt; no informal address detected in these rows.

hi.register: Respectful imperative/progress constructions where direct guidance appears; no second-person pronoun policy found in repo.

id.register: Anda is used for direct address; descriptive labels do not need a pronoun.

ja.register: Polite ください/ます forms for user-directed guidance; loading status lines are descriptive.

ko.register: Polite 하세요/세요 forms for user guidance; provider labels and loading states are not honorific address.

pt-BR.register: Polite você/third-person imperative forms (e.g. Verifique, Seja); possessive sua.

vi.register: Neutral/polite Hãy for user guidance; descriptive values do not address the reader.

zh-Hans.register: 请 used for user-directed guidance; other values are labels or descriptive copy.

zh-Hant.register: 請 used for user-directed guidance; other values are labels or descriptive copy.

reviewScope: All 600 cells checked for formality/register where the source or target uses direct address, an imperative, or a loading instruction.
